script: They were making fun of this player for shooting his free throws underhand. Even though he made the free throws, the fans kept mocking his technique, so if the underhand free throw is so successful, why does no one use it in today's NBA? You see, after Rick Barry, the man who popularized it retired, he tried convincing Shaq to use it because he was one of the worst free throw shooters ever. And the underhand free throw helped Rick shoot 91% from the line! But Shaq said he'd rather miss every free throw than look stupid on the court.
